handled specially below         ('deoxyribonucleic', 10),         ('genome', 7),         ('genetic', 5),         ('nucleotide', 6),         ('base pair', 6),         ('double helix', 8),         ('sequenc', 5),         ('chromosome', 5),         ('crispr', 8),         ('pcr', 6),         ('rna', 3),         ('q-bio', 5),     ],     'music_history': [         ('music history', 12),         ('composer', 7),         ('symphony', 7),         ('orchestra', 5),         ('opera', 5),         ('baroque', 8),         ('renaissance', 8),         ('medieval', 8),         ('classical', 6),         ('romantic', 6),         ('jazz', 6),         ('bach', 8),         ('mozart', 8),         ('beethoven', 8),         ('sonata', 5),         ('concerto', 5),         ('harmonic', 2),     ], }  word_boundary_re = re.compile(r" DNA ", re.IGNORECASE)   def extract_pdf_text(p: Path) -> str:     # first 2 pages are usually enough (title/abstract)     try:         out = subprocess.check_output(             ['pdftotext', '-f', '1', '-l', '2', str(p), '-'],             stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,             timeout=40,         )         return out.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')     except Exception:         try:             out = subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext', str(p), '-'], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=80)             return out.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')         except Exception:             return ''   def extract_docx_text(p: Path) -> str:     try:         with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:             xml = z.read('word/document.xml')         root = ET.fromstring(xml)         parts = []         for el in root.iter():             if el.tag.endswith('}t') and el.text:                 parts.append(el.text)         return '
'.join(parts)     except Exception:         return ''   def extract_pptx_text(p: Path) -> str:     try:         with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:             names = [n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('ppt/slides/slide') and n.endswith('.xml')]             names.sort()             parts = []             for n in names:                 try:                     root = ET.fromstring(z.read(n))                     for el in root.iter():                         if el.tag.endswith('}t') and el.text:                             parts.append(el.text)                 except Exception:                     continue         return '
'.join(parts)     except Exception:         return ''   def normalize(s: str) -> str:     s = s.replace('\x00', ' ')     s = s.lower()     s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)     return s   def score(text_norm: str, cat_key: str) -> int:     s = 0     for kw, w in patterns[cat_key]:         if kw == ' dna ':             # special: count word-boundary DNA occurrences             s += len(word_boundary_re.findall(text_norm)) * 6             continue         s += text_norm.count(kw) * w     return s   def classify(text: str) -> tuple[str, dict]:     t = normalize(text)     scores = {k: score(t, k) for k, _ in CATS}     best = max(scores.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0]     if scores[best] == 0:         best = 'music_history'     return best, scores   # Create destination folders for k, folder in CATS:     (BASE / folder).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  files = [p for p in SRC.iterdir() if p.is_file() and not p.name.startswith('.')] files.sort(key=lambda p: p.name.lower())  moved = [] counts = {k: 0 for k, _ in CATS} low_conf = [] errors = []  for p in files:     ext = p.suffix.lower()     if ext == '.pdf':         text = extract_pdf_text(p)     elif ext == '.docx':         text = extract_docx_text(p)     elif ext == '.pptx':         text = extract_pptx_text(p)     else:         text = p.name      cat, scores = classify(text)     dst_dir = BASE / dict(CATS)[cat]     dst = dst_dir / p.name      if dst.exists():         errors.append((p.name, f'destination exists: {dst}'))         continue      try:         shutil.move(str(p), str(dst))         moved.append((p.name, cat, scores))         counts[cat] += 1         if max(scores.values()) < 12:             low_conf.append((p.name, cat, scores))     except Exception as e:         errors.append((p.name, f'move failed: {e}'))  print('--- moved counts ---') for k, _ in CATS:     print(f'{k:20s} {counts[k]}')  if errors:     print('
--- errors ---')     for name, msg in errors:         print(name, '->', msg)  print('
--- low confidence (first 25) ---') for name, cat, scores in low_conf[:25]:     top = sorted(scores.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)[:3]     print(f'{name} -> {cat} | top: {top}')  # Remove empty SRC directory if empty try:     if SRC.exists() and not any(SRC.iterdir()):         SRC.rmdir() except Exception:     pass PY
